resources.string:
YourIPTV is an independent media player for playlists you are authorized to use. No television channels, subscriptions or user accounts are supplied by the app.

DATA ON YOUR DEVICE
Playlist URLs, provider usernames and passwords, guide data, viewing history, favorites and preferences are stored in the Android application sandbox. Provider credentials and URLs in the local database are not additionally encrypted by the app. PINs are stored as salted hashes. Android backup is disabled. Uninstalling the app or clearing its storage removes its private data. You can delete playlists and clear viewing history in Settings.

NETWORK REQUESTS
Your device contacts the provider, playlist, guide, stream and artwork servers referenced by your configuration. Those servers receive your IP address, request headers, and any credentials needed for their service. They have their own privacy practices. This Google Play application requires HTTPS for network sources, including provider, playlist, guide, stream and artwork requests. Insecure HTTP connections and HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects are blocked. Existing HTTP-only sources need a working HTTPS address from their provider before they can connect. YourIPTV uses platform certificate validation and does not bypass it. Google Play manages app delivery and updates under Google's privacy practices. Playback does not require a Play Store connection.

NO ADVERTISING OR ANALYTICS
The app contains no advertising, analytics, crash-reporting service or developer account service, and does not send your playlists or viewing history to the developer. Content providers and artwork hosts can process requests independently.

EXPORTS AND RECORDINGS
A backup you explicitly create contains playlist credentials and URLs in readable JSON; PINs and local Settings Lock state are excluded. Protect exported files and share them only with trusted recipients. Recordings and files you select through Android's document picker stay in the destination you choose. Deleting this app does not delete files you exported elsewhere.

CHILDREN AND CONTROLS
The player does not supply content for children or verify content suitability. Owners manage authorized sources, parental PINs and category restrictions independently of Settings Lock.

CONTACT
YourIPTV support: https://youriptv.us
This in-app policy is available offline from About.
